title: Ergopti+ tap-hold configuration (shared)
description: JSON Schema for _shared/tap_hold/defaults.toml AND for the user's tap_hold.toml, one layout on every OS (_shared/tap_hold/SCHEMA.md): the keys and the global delay. The Tap-Holds switch, the one-shot and lone-tap timings and the key combinations are config.toml rows (config.schema.json [tap_holds], [mod_combos]) since schema v22. The shared defaults are read at runtime on every boot; the user file is laid over them key by key on Windows, and on Linux when it sets [tap_hold] inherit_defaults = true.

schema_version.description: The version of the user file, written by the Linux driver and migrated at boot by _shared/tap_hold/migrations.toml. Absent: an unstamped file from before versioning.

inherit_defaults.description: Lays the file over the shipped recommendation key by key.

time_activation_seconds.description: The GLOBAL delay in seconds: what every key without a delay of its own waits before its hold fires. Absent: the timing registry's tap_hold.default_activation_ms.

explicit_delays.description: Retired. No driver reads or writes it; the v0_to_v1 migration (_shared/tap_hold/migrations.toml) uses it once, to leave the delays of a flagged file alone, and removes it.

karabiner.description: macOS only: the Karabiner integration (ADR 011). Windows and Linux never read or write it.

runtime.description: Which Karabiner runtime the rules target.

close_other_instances.description: Whether the owned runtime may close another Karabiner-Elements.

keys_map.description: Map of physical-key names to tap-hold configuration.

enabled.description: Defaults to true. Set false to disable this tap-hold without removing the section.

time_activation_seconds.description: This key's OWN hold delay in seconds, set by the user. Absent: the key follows the global delay. Below = tap_action; above = hold_*.

hold_action.description: macOS only: a hold that is neither a modifier nor a layer, a macOS action id. Windows and Linux warn once and hold nothing.

tap_action.description: Action emitted on tap. Reference to _shared/modules/gestures/actions.toml entry or a key name.

hold_layer.description: Layer activated while held: one of [tap_hold.hold_picker].layers. What the layer does is bound in _shared/keymap/layers.recommended.toml and the user's layers.toml, not here.

allOf.description: hold_layer, hold_modifier and hold_action are mutually exclusive.
